decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the core range and given its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and investment, so with no clear evidence of failure management would be very likely to persist.

This serum fits the firm's established natural facial-care business, and even though public commitment seems more limited than for Product A, the lack of negative market evidence makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.

The cleansing milk is also close to the existing offer, so sunk development and launch effort favor retention, although its lower visibility on the website makes it slightly easier to discontinue than the more prominently committed products.
